Title: Generally available: Exporting device customizations and cloud properties in Azure IoT Central

Body.Content:
To better support reuse of device template definitions, device capability customizations (color, min/max values, decimal places, etc.) as well as cloud properties are now included in exported device templates in Azure IoT Central. As part of this change, the experience for creating and editing cloud properties has moved from its own tab to the device interface experience as its own capability type (along with Property, Command and Telemetry).  In addition, capability customizations are also now part of the device interface and the "Customization" tab has been removed. 

 

Learn more about Creating a Device Template in Azure IoT Central.
